{{2026 Indian Premier League Teams}}

The [[2026 Indian Premier League]] was the 19th edition of the [[Indian Premier League]] (IPL), a professional [[Twenty20]] (T20) [[cricket]] league held in India, which was organised by the [[Board of Control for Cricket in India]] (BCCI). It has been held annually since the [[2008 Indian Premier League|first edition in 2008]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Indian Premier League |url=https://www.britannica.com/topic/Indian-Premier-League |access-date=16 December 2025 |website=[[Britannica.com]] |language=en-uk|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250317155833/https://www.britannica.com/topic/Indian-Premier-League|archive-date=17 March 2025|url-status=live}}</ref> In July 2024, the [[Indian Premier League#Organization|IPL Governing Council]] announced that a mega auction would be conducted for the 2025 season followed by mini auctions in 2026 and 2027.<ref>{{cite news|date=31 July 2024|title=IPL Owners Meeting – Update|url=https://www.iplt20.com/news/4107/ipl-owners-meeting-update|access-date=28 October 2024|website=[[IPLT20.com]]|archive-date=27 November 2024|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241127050427/https://www.iplt20.com/news/4107/ipl-owners-meeting-update|url-status=live}}</ref>

The franchises were required to submit their retention lists before 15 November 2025, and a total of 173 players were retained ahead of the auction. The auction was held on 16 December 2025 in [[Abu Dhabi]], United Arab Emirates, with the auction purse for each franchise set at {{INRConvert|125|c|lk=on}}. A total of 1,355 players registered for the auction, of which 369 players were shortlisted and 156 were featured in the auction and 77 were sold in the auction. [[Cameron Green]] became the most expensive overseas player and the third most expensive player in the history of the IPL when he was bought by [[Kolkata Knight Riders]] for {{INRConvert|25.20|c|lk=on}}.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IPL auction 2026: Australia's Cameron Green becomes most expensive overseas player in tournament's history |url=https://www.skysports.com/cricket/news/12040/13484111/ipl-auction-2026-australias-cameron-green-becomes-most-expensive-overseas-player-in-tournaments-history |access-date=23 December 2025|work=[[Sky Sports]]}}</ref> [[Prashant Veer]] and [[Kartik Sharma]] became the joint-most expensive uncapped players in the history of the IPL when they were both bought by [[Chennai Super Kings]] for {{INRConvert|14.20|c|lk=on}} each.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Who are Kartik Sharma and Prashant Veer - the costliest uncapped buys? |url=https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/136917/who-are-kartik-sharma-and-prashant-veer-the-costliest-uncapped-buys-cricbuzzcom |access-date=23 December 2025|publisher=[[Cricbuzz]]}}</ref> The 79 unsold players included players such as [[Jake Fraser-McGurk]], [[Jonny Bairstow]], [[Daryl Mitchell (New Zealand cricketer)|Daryl Mitchell]], [[Devon Conway]], [[Alzarri Joseph]], [[Gus Atkinson]], [[Deepak Hooda]] and [[Karn Sharma]].<ref name="unsold">{{Cite web |title=Unsold players at IPL 2026 auction: Jake Fraser-McGurk, Deepak Hooda among big names - get full list |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/ipl-2026-auction-unsold-player-list-indian-premier-league |access-date=23 December 2025|website=[[Olympics.com]]}}</ref>

== Player retention ==
=== Retention policy ===
The ten franchises were allowed to retain any number of players from their squad,<ref name="TOI"/> including traded players while excluding players signed as temporary replacements.<ref>{{cite web |date=30 October 2024 |title=IPL to allow temporary replacements for last leg of 2025 season |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-to-allow-franchises-sign-temporary-replacement-players-for-last-leg-of-2025-season-1485918 |access-date=23 May 2025 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]]}}</ref> The auction purse for each franchise was set at {{INRConvert|125|c|lk=on}}.<ref name="retain2"/> Franchises were deducted a specific amount from the auction purse for every retained player.<ref name="TOI">{{Cite news |date=2025-11-12 |title=IPL 2026 retention rules explained: How many players can a franchise retain or release before auction? |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/ipl-2026-retention-rules-explained-how-many-players-can-a-franchise-retain-or-release-before-auction/articleshow/125275371.cms |access-date=2025-12-23 |work=[[The Times of India]] |issn=0971-8257 |archive-date=13 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251113035257/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/ipl-2026-retention-rules-explained-how-many-players-can-a-franchise-retain-or-release-before-auction/articleshow/125275371.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

=== Retained players ===
The franchises were required to submit their retention lists before 15 November 2025,<ref>{{Cite web |title=IPL 2026 Retention: All you need to know ahead of deadline on November 15 |url=https://www.business-standard.com/cricket/ipl/ipl-2026-retention-all-you-need-to-know-ahead-of-deadline-on-november-15-125110900252_1.html |access-date=23 December 2025 |work=[[Business Standard]]}}</ref> and a total of 173 players were retained ahead of the auction.<ref>{{Cite web |title=TATA IPL 2026 Player Retentions Announced |url=https://www.iplt20.com/news/4247/tata-ipl-2026-player-retentions-announced |access-date=23 December 2025 |website=[[IPLT20.com]]}}</ref>

* Sources: [[Board of Control for Cricket in India|BCCI]],<ref name="retain1">[[#Retention List|IPL Retained Players 2026]]</ref> [[Cricinfo]],<ref name="retain2">{{Cite web |title=IPL 2026: How the squads stack up ahead of the auction |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2026-how-the-squads-stack-up-1511304 |access-date=23 December 2025 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]] |archive-date=16 November 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251116181308/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2026-how-the-squads-stack-up-1511304 |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Olympics.com]]<ref name="retain3">{{Cite web |title=IPL 2026 retention: Full list of players retained and released |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/indian-premier-league-ipl-2026-retention-list-players-released-cricket |access-date=23 December 2025 |website=[[Olympics.com]]}}</ref>

== Auction ==
Any player willing to play in the IPL was required to register for the auction. Players who did not register for the 2025 mega auction are ineligible to participate in the mini-auctions held in the subsequent years.<ref>{{cite web |date=29 April 2024 |title=IPL 2025: The logic behind Rs 18 crore cap on foreign players and why they have to register for this year's auction |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/cricket/ipl-auction-2025-retention-foreign-player-register-9594869/ |access-date=1 October 2024 |work=[[The Indian Express]] |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930211005/https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/cricket/ipl-auction-2025-retention-foreign-player-register-9594869/ |url-status=live}}</ref> Any auctioned player who withdrew before the 2025 season without legitimate reason or injury is banned from the IPL for a period of two years.<ref>{{cite web |title=Two-year ban for overseas players pulling out after being picked at IPL auction |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-two-year-ban-for-overseas-players-pulling-out-after-being-picked-at-auction-1453019 |access-date=1 October 2024 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]] |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930194531/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2025-two-year-ban-for-overseas-players-pulling-out-after-being-picked-at-auction-1453019 |url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=29 September 2024 |title=Franchise purse for IPL 2025 auction and the new 'match fee' component |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/explained-franchise-purse-for-ipl-2025-auction-and-the-new-match-fee-component/articleshow/113777845.cms |access-date=1 October 2024 |work=[[The Times of India]] |issn=0971-8257 |archive-date=30 September 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240930170544/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/sports/cricket/ipl/top-stories/explained-franchise-purse-for-ipl-2025-auction-and-the-new-match-fee-component/articleshow/113777845.cms |url-status=live}}</ref>

The auction was held on 16 December 2025 in [[Abu Dhabi]], United Arab Emirates.<ref>{{cite web |access-date=15 December 2025 |title=IPL auction set to take place on December 16 in Abu Dhabi |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2026-auction-to-take-place-on-december-16-in-abu-dhabi-1510968 |publisher=[[Cricinfo]] |archive-date=5 January 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260105022626/https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-2026-auction-to-take-place-on-december-16-in-abu-dhabi-1510968 |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Mallika Sagar]] was appointed as the [[auctioneer]] for the third consecutive year, after she hosted the [[List of 2024 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2024]] and [[List of 2025 Indian Premier League personnel changes|2025]] auctions.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2025-12-16 |title=IPL Auction 2026: Who is Mallika Sagar? Meet the auctioneer set to lead the big day |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/new-updates/ipl-auction-2026-who-is-mallika-sagar-meet-the-auctioneer-set-to-lead-the-big-day/articleshow/125998470.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2025-12-23 |work=[[The Economic Times]] |issn=0013-0389 |archive-date=17 December 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251217012220/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/new-updates/ipl-auction-2026-who-is-mallika-sagar-meet-the-auctioneer-set-to-lead-the-big-day/articleshow/125998470.cms?from=mdr |url-status=live }}</ref> A total of 1,355 players registered for the auction, of which 369 players were shortlisted and 156 were featured in the auction and 77 were sold in the auction.<ref name="sold1"/><ref name="sold2"/><ref name="unsold"/>

=== Sold players ===
Ten sets of players were divided based on their specialisation: [[Batting (cricket)|batters]], [[all-rounder]]s, [[wicket keeper batter]]s, [[Fast bowling|fast bowlers]] and [[Spin bowling|spin bowlers]]; and status: [[capped]] and uncapped. The capped players went up for bidding first followed by the uncapped players. After player no. 70, the auction entered its accelerated phase, covering all the remaining players. During the accelerated round, players were presented based on the franchises' preference.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Brar |first=Hemant |date=13 December 2025 |title=FAQs - The when, where, who and how much of the IPL 2026 auction |url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/ipl-auction-2026-faqs-when-where-who-and-how-much-1515453 |access-date=3 June 2026|publisher=[[Cricinfo]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-11 |title=IPL Auction Guide: Meaning, Rules, Retentions and Player Bidding |url=https://sportstar.thehindu.com/cricket/ipl/ipl-news/what-is-ipl-auction-explained-rules-process-faq/article70383365.ece |access-date=2026-06-03 |work=[[Sportstar]] |language=en}}</ref>

* Sources: [[Cricinfo]],<ref name="sold1">{{ESPNcricinfo 2|auction-sub|id=ipl-2026-auction-1515016|sub=sold players|event=2026 Indian Premier League auction|access-date=23 December 2025|dynamic=n|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251223103935/https://www.espncricinfo.com/auction/ipl-2026-auction-1515016/sold-players|archive-date=23 December 2025}}</ref> [[Olympics.com]]<ref name="sold2">{{Cite web |title=IPL 2026 player list - full squads of each team |url=https://www.olympics.com/en/news/ipl-2026-teams-squads-list-player-prices |access-date=23 December 2025 |website=[[Olympics.com]]}}</ref>

== Withdrawn players ==
The following players were ruled out and/or unavailable for the rest of the season due to either injury or national duties. The franchises were allowed to pick a replacement player from the unsold players at the auction to replace the withdrawn players.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IPL replacement rules: When an outsider is allowed |url=https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/133739/ipl-replacement-rules-when-an-outsider-is-allowed-cricbuzzcom |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251206052738/https://www.cricbuzz.com/cricket-news/133739/ipl-replacement-rules-when-an-outsider-is-allowed-cricbuzzcom |archive-date=2025-12-06 |access-date=2026-06-03 |publisher=[[Cricbuzz]] |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |title=TATA IPL 2026 |url=https://documents.iplt20.com/bcci/documents/1774265031558_TATA_IPL_2026_Match_Playing_Conditions.pdf |date=10 March 2026 |journal=[[Indian Premier League#Rules and format|Indian Premier League, playing conditions]] |publisher=[[Board of Control for Cricket in India]] |volume=19 |access-date=3 June 2026 }}</ref>
